title: ONE chain of record: world -> chassis -> arm_base -> base_link -> link1..link6 -> gripper_end -> racket_mount -> racket_root -> racket_contact_frame
rule: no measured number is stored twice: every numeric edge is a pointer (file + sha256 + JSON pointer) into the committed evidence, and every edge that the assets cannot answer is UNKNOWN with no numeric payload

naming_reconciliation.p6_arm_root_prim == p3_arm_base: P6 edge 3 asserts arm_root_prim -> arm_base_link with the identity root_joint, and P3 names the same prim 'arm_base'; this merge keeps ONE node name (arm_base) for that frame and records the alias instead of forking the chain

A_usdgeom_xformops_authoritative.what: chassis -> arm_base -> base_link -> link1..link6 -> gripper_end composed from the P3-01 UsdGeom xformOp hops (pxr-verified slice)

B_p6_physics_joint_anchors.what: chassis -> arm_base -> base_link -> link1..link6 -> gripper_end composed from the P6 joint anchors (physics:localPos0 + physics:localRot0)

open_issue.finding: composing the P6 revolute edges as child-link poses does NOT reproduce the pxr-composed gripper_end pose: the USD joint frame of a body carries TWO local poses (physics:localPos0/localRot0 on body0 and physics:localPos1/localRot1 on body1), and the P6 frame tree records only the body0 side. Both compositions are proper rotations (det R = +1), so neither is a handedness bug - the gap is a missing localPos1/localRot1 per joint, not a wrong number.
open_issue.consequence_for_this_merge: the merged chain uses composition A (UsdGeom xformOps) as the chain of record; the P6 layer is kept for its per-edge provenance and joint limits, and its revolute edge numbers are NOT reinterpreted as child-link poses
open_issue.next_action: extract physics:localPos1/localRot1 for joints 1..6 from the read-only arm USD and re-check A vs B; until then B stays a diagnostic, not a datum

guards.rule: a numeric edge carries value_ref only; tests fail if a translation_m / rotation_quat payload is added next to the pointer
edges 1, 2, 13, 14, 15 must keep translation_m/rotation_quat absent; a test fails if anyone silently fills the mount with a guess
the P3 identity is attached to edge 2 as p3_01_anchor and never changes the physical status: the mount offset stays unmeasured
